user_confirmed_scope: Include related journals, confirmed in this chat on October 13, 2026.
counting_scope: 55 named journal titles, including one historical predecessor; selected target set, not an exhaustive publisher census.

pilot_throughput.note: Nine selected table-heavy pages; not a full-paper or production-throughput benchmark. Excludes initialization/downloads and downstream QA.

filesystem.note: Shared filesystem free space, not a reserved user quota.

download_probe.note: Availability probes, not representative sampling. Three are accepted manuscripts; no inference was run on these six documents.

limitations: Filter biology and article type before fixing the training/evidence corpus. Availability counts include reviews and other article types.
Candidate counts use official PMC filters; actual object presence and article versions must be verified during ingestion.
Counts were queried sequentially; the index can update between calls. Combined counts come from Boolean unions, not summing family counts.
Keep PDF/XML originals, hashes, PMCID/DOI, version and license provenance. Preserve the frozen nine-page comparison separately.
